name: Link Augmenter
description: A Date Augmenter plugin that injects links into date displays.
project_description:
Provides options for adding a link to your date output. An example use would be linking to your group's meetup page to RSVP, or directing users to a registration webform. By default links will only be added to upcoming events, but this module can be configured to add its links to all events.

 The URL and link text fields support the use of tokens, and there is planned support for placeholders to include date information such as field delta, or a timestamp or ISO 8601 formatted output (e.g. 2021-02-12T15:19:21+00:00).
